sources.label: A Morphe patch that adds Catppuccin themes to various apps including Todoist, GB
sources.author: Morphe - Catppuccin
patch_list: Replace Fastmail dark mode with Catppuccin Macchiato and mauve accents. Light mode remains available.
Use your TTF font in Fastmail's interface. Repatch an original APK to change or remove it.
